title: Timothée Chalamet's birth chart
metaDescription: Timothée Chalamet's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 5.5° Capricorn. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Five of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Capricorn — the Sun, Mercury, Mars, Uranus and Neptune. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Capricorn, but precisely: 5.5°, first decan, 0°–10°, under Saturn in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 23.6° Capricorn, Venus at 7.3° Aquarius, Mars at 20.8° Capricorn. Mercury in an earth sign reads as a mind that trusts the measured and the checked; Venus in an air sign reads as taste led by wit and proportion; Mars in an earth sign reads as drive that grinds rather than flares.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mercury and Neptune — a conjunction holding at 0.9°. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, Mars sextile Saturn at 1.7°, and Uranus sextile Pluto at 2.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These angles were checked through every hour of that civil day and survive throughout, which is why an unrecorded hour does not disturb them.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Venus stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, two sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Mars in Capricorn at 20.8° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Jupiter in Sagittarius at 28.5° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 5 earth, 2 water, 2 fire, 1 air; by modality, 5 cardinal, 4 mutable, 1 fixed. Earth counts what remains: the built, the kept, the finished. Promise weighs less than delivery. Not one planet was retrograde, so the whole chart reads in direct motion.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.5° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 22.1°.
